blocks.text: PENONOMÉ, Panama—A powerful magnitude 7.7 earthquake rocked Panama on Friday, causing buildings and roads to collapse in the center of the country. There were no immediate reports of casualties. The shallow tremor was felt across the Central American nation of around 4.5 million people, according to the National Civil Protection System. It lasted for around a minute. In Panama City, about 200 kilometers from the epicenter, there were scenes of panic as people rushed to evacuate from the city’s emblematic skyscrapers. “I was scared because the shaking was very strong and prolonged.
